items.raw_excerpt: Estrutura improvisada foi retirada pela prefeitura na segunda-feira (31). Morador, que não teve nome divulgado, foi incluído em programa de assistência social.
items.summary_en: A homeless man in Recife built a makeshift shelter in a tree. City workers removed the structure on Monday. The man was connected to a social assistance program.
items.summary_ko: 레시피의 한 노숙자가 나무 위에 임시 거처를 만들었습니다. 시 당국은 월요일 해당 구조물을 철거했습니다. 해당 남성은 사회복지 프로그램에 연계되었습니다.
items.title_en: Homeless Man's Tree House Removed by City in Recife

items.raw_excerpt: In July, Eyewitness News reported that residents built the bridge using wooden logs, sticks and corrugated iron sheets to connect two remote villages in Burgersfort.
items.summary_en: A makeshift bridge built from wooden logs, sticks, and corrugated iron collapsed in Limpopo, South Africa. The bridge connected two remote villages and gave residents access to a nearby clinic. People in the area are now cut off from medical services again.
items.summary_ko: 림포포주 원격 마을 two개를 잇던 나무 기둥과 철판으로 만든 임시 다리가 무너졌다. 이 다리는 주민들이 인근 보건소를 이용하는 유일한 통로였다. 붕괴 후 주민들은 다시 의료 서비스 이용이 어려워졌다.
items.title_en: Makeshift bridge collapses in Limpopo, cutting off village from clinic
items.title_ko: 남아공 림포포, 임시 다리 붕괴로 마을과 보건소 단절
items.title_original: Limpopo village again cut off from nearby clinic after makeshift bridge collapses - EWN

items.raw_excerpt: To assume that 'Europeans don't tip' would be a serious blunder. Here's a quick guide to tipping in Germany, from the standard amount to the cool and easy way to do so.
items.summary_en: Tipping is expected in Germany and there are standard amounts to follow. This guide explains the right amounts and the easy way to tip when dining or getting services in Germany.
items.summary_ko: 독일에서는 팁을 주는 것이 일반적이며 적정 금액이 있습니다. 이 가이드는 독일에서 식사나 서비스 이용 시 적절한 팁 금액과 간편한 방법을 알려줍니다.
items.title_en: How much should I tip in Germany?
items.title_original: How much should I tip in Germany?

items.raw_excerpt: If you’re a non-native Spanish speaker who wants to obtain Spanish nationality after ten years of residency, you will have to sit a Spanish language exam if you want to obtain citizenship. Is your Spanish good enough?
items.summary_en: If you have lived in Spain for ten years and want to become a citizen, you must pass a Spanish language test. The test checks if your Spanish is good enough for daily life and work. This rule applies to all non-native speakers who apply for Spanish nationality.
items.summary_ko: 스페인에서 10년간 거주한 뒤 시민권을 받으려면 스페인어 시험을 통과해야 합니다. 시험은 일상생활과 업무에 충분한 수준인지 확인합니다. 외국인 지원자 모두에게 동일한 기준이 적용됩니다.
items.title_en: How good does my Spanish language level have to be to get citizenship?
items.title_ko: 스페인 시민권 취득에 필요한 스페인어 수준은?
items.title_original: How good does my Spanish language level have to be to get citizenship?

items.raw_excerpt: Austrian German is 'more beautiful and correct' than standard German, according to Austrians who took part in a new comprehensive language survey.
items.summary_en: A new language survey found that Austrians consider their own German to be more beautiful and correct than the standard version spoken in Germany. Many Austrians feel their local dialect is more pleasant to hear and more natural to use in daily life. The results show how people across German-speaking countries take pride in their own way of speaking.
items.summary_ko: 새로운 언어 조사에서 오스트리아인들은 자신들의 독일어가 독일 표준어보다 더 아름답고 올바르다고 생각하는 것으로 나타났다. 많은 오스트리아인은 자국의 사투리가 듣기에 더 좋고 일상에서 사용하기 더 자연스럽다고 느끼고 있다. 이번 결과는 독일어권 국가별로 각자 자신들의 말하기 방식에 자부심을 가지고 있음을 보여준다.
items.title_en: Austrians say their German is better than standard German
items.title_ko: 오스트리아인, 우리 독일어가 독일 표준어보다 낫다
items.title_original: 'Melts on the tongue': Why Austrians prefer their German to standard German

items.raw_excerpt: Used booksellers in Canada are navigating how to handle mysterious bulk orders, as suspicions grow that companies are buying up their old books so they can be scanned for AI training — and then trashed.
items.summary_en: Used bookstores across Canada are noticing large unusual orders that may come from companies wanting to scan books for AI training data. Owners fear the books could be shredded after scanning. Many shops are now limiting how many old books a single buyer can purchase at once.
items.summary_ko: 캐나다 전역의 중고서점들이 AI 학습 데이터를 만들기 위한 대량 스캔 의심 주문을 자주 받고 있다. 주인들은 스캔 후 책이 파쇄될까 봐 우려하고 있다. nhiều 가게들은 한 명의 구매자가 한번에 살 수 있는 오래된 책 수량을 제한하기 시작했다.
items.title_en: Canadian used bookstores see suspicious bulk orders for AI scanning
items.title_ko: 캐나다 중고서점들, AI 학습용 스캔 의심 대량 주문 급증
items.title_original: Used bookstores navigate 'suspicious' bulk orders amid AI book-shredding fears

items.raw_excerpt: 2025 was the final year of higher pension accrual rates for 53- to 62-year-olds.
items.summary_en: Last year was the final year when people aged 53 to 62 in Finland got higher pension accrual rates. Among them, 54-year-olds received the biggest increase in pension benefits. The special pension boost period has now ended.
items.summary_ko: 지난해는 핀란드 53~62세 근로자가 높은 연금 적립률을 적용받은 마지막 해였다. 그중 54세가 가장 큰 폭의 연금 혜택을 받았다. 특별 연금 적립 기간은 이제 종료되었다.
items.title_en: 54-year-olds got the biggest pension boost last year
items.title_ko: 54세, 지난해 연금 혜택 가장 크게 받아
items.title_original: 54-year-olds got the biggest pension boost last year

items.raw_excerpt: A record number of tourists visited Stockholm this summer, according to figures reviewed by the Stockholm Chamber of Commerce.
items.summary_en: Stockholm welcomed a record number of tourists this summer. The Stockholm Chamber of Commerce reviewed the latest figures and confirmed the all-time high.
items.summary_ko: 올여름 스톡홀름을 방문한 관광객 수가 역대 최고를 기록했습니다. 스톡홀름 상공회의소가 최신 통계를 분석해 사상 최대 방문객 수를 확인했습니다.
items.title_en: Stockholm hits record summer tourist numbers

items.raw_excerpt: If your Spanish residency permit application is denied, you will probably receive a letter giving you 15 days' notice to leave the country. But does this actually mean it's mandatory for you to leave Spain or face being deported?
items.summary_en: If your Spanish residency permit application is denied, you may receive a letter giving you 15 days to leave the country. However, this notice does not always mean you must leave immediately or face deportation. There are steps you can take to respond to the decision.
items.summary_ko: 스페인 거주 허가 신청이 거부되면, 15일 이내에 출국하라는 통보서를 받을 수 있습니다. 하지만 이 통보가 곧바로 강제 추방을 의미하는 것은 아닙니다. 이의를 제기하거나 법적 절차를 밟을 방법이 있습니다.
items.title_en: Do I have to leave Spain if my residency permit is denied?
items.title_ko: 거주 허가가 거부되면 스페인을 떠나야 하나요?
items.title_original: Do I have to leave Spain if my residency permit is denied?

items.raw_excerpt: September is here and the days are getting shorter, darker and colder which means it's much harder to get enough vitamin D if you live in Norway. So is now the right time to start taking a supplement?
items.summary_en: September brings shorter, darker days in Norway. Getting enough vitamin D from sunlight becomes much harder. Now may be the right time to consider taking a supplement.
items.summary_ko: 9월이 되면 노르웨이의 낮이 점점 짧아지고 어두워진다. 햇빛으로 충분한 비타민D를 섭취하기가 훨씬 어려워진다. 지금이 보충제를 시작하기에 적절한 시기일 수 있다.
items.title_en: When to start vitamin D supplements in Norway

items.title_original: When is a good time to start vitamin D supplements in Norway?

items.raw_excerpt: A new round of construction will affect several tram routes and a U6 station from September, with some restrictions continuing until the end of the year.
items.summary_en: Construction work will disrupt several tram routes and a U6 station in Vienna starting in September. Some restrictions will last until the end of the year.

items.raw_excerpt: VVD MP Renate den Hollander has resigned from the management board of a vets’ lobby group after facing questions about her role as the party’s spokesman on animal welfare. NOS reported that some of Den Hollander’s comments in parliament were almost identical to statements made by the BPW, an organisation representing owners of veterinary practices. Den Hollander, 49, spent 22 as a vet and ran her own practice in Drenthe before being elected to parliament for the first time last...
items.summary_en: A Dutch parliament member resigned from a veterinary lobby board after questions about possible conflicts of interest. Her parliamentary statements appeared nearly identical to statements from the vets' group she represented.
items.summary_ko: 네덜란드 하원의원이 수의사 로비 단체 이사직에서 사임했다. 자신이 대변하던 수의사 단체의 성명과 거의 동일한 내용을 의회에서 발언한 사실이 드러나 이해충돌 의혹이 제기됐다.

items.raw_excerpt: Toronto begins a three-game series in Cleveland on Tuesday that will give the Blue Jays a shot at moving up in the standings at a critical time in the season.
items.summary_en: Toronto starts a three-game series in Cleveland on Tuesday. The Blue Jays have a chance to move up in the standings at a key point in the season.

items.raw_excerpt: After my first hours exploring the Giardini at the Venice Biennale, one thing became impossible to ignore: Contemporary art is escaping the frame.
items.summary_en: At the Venice Biennale, visitors exploring the Giardini gardens found that contemporary art is moving beyond traditional frames and walls. The open-air setting of the gardens lets art blend with nature and public spaces in surprising ways.
items.summary_ko: 베니스 비엔날레에서 자르디니 공원을 거닐던 방문객들은 현대미술이 전통적인 액자와 벽의 틀을 벗어나고 있다는 것을 발견했습니다. 공원의 야외 공간은 예술이 자연과 공공장소와 예상치 못한 방식으로 어우러지게 합니다.
items.title_en: Contemporary Art Breaks Free at Venice Biennale Gardens

items.title_original: When Art Escapes the Frame: Inside the Giardini
